figurative_meaning_bn: অপরের কাজের সাথে নিজের কাজের সঙ্গতি রাখা
figurative_meaning_en: To maintain harmony or synchronization between one's own actions and those of others
example_sentences_in_bangla: দলের সাথে তাল রেখে কাজ করতে হবে।
জীবনে সকলের সাথে তাল রেখে চলো।
example_sentences_in_english: You have to keep in step with the team's work.
In life, keep pace with everyone around you.
note: Derived from musical and rhythmic traditions in Bengali folk culture
